His primary feedback is that many customers feel the 90-day no-interest period is too short and are unable to pay off their balances within that timeframe. As a result, some customers choose competitors such as Affirm because they perceive the repayment terms to be more manageable.

He confirmed that he has sufficient marketing materials on hand and expressed enthusiasm about earning Amazon gift card rewards through funded applications. Overall, he remains engaged and committed to growing production.

I discussed alternative options available to customers, including using their approved EasyPay amount toward a portion of the purchase and paying the remaining balance out of pocket. I also advised that customers may contact our Customer Service Department to request a potential approval increase of up to $200, subject to qualification.

Sam stated that he currently has several customers with pre-approved and funded applications and plans to follow up with them today. He also mentioned that business has been particularly slow this week, resulting in fewer customers seeking financing assistance and a lower volume of applications overall.
